tools.name: about_board
tools.description: What Mostra is, what putting a product on the wall does for its exposure, the posting rules and limits, and the FAQ. Read this first, and use it to explain the value to the user before they decide to publish.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Lists products currently on the wall, newest first. Optional text query and category filter.

tools.name: publish_product
tools.description: Puts a poster for the user's product on the wall. Requires the user's API key. The user must have asked for this and approved the title, description, website and image: call it first with dry_run=true, show the user the result, and only then publish. tools.name: list_my_posters
tools.description: The user's posters with days left on the board, views, clicks, likes, and how many free slots are in use. Requires the API key.

tools.name: get_share_text
tools.description: Ready-made text and link for sharing a poster on social networks. Show it to the user and only post it with their approval.

tools.name: get_badge_html
tools.description: HTML for a small badge the user can put on their own website. It links visitors to the poster.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_share_text, get_badge_html · Private data: publish_product, list_my_posters · Public sink: about_board, publish_product, get_share_text.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_share_text, get_badge_html · Private data: publish_product, list_my_posters · Public sink: about_board, publish_product, get_share_text

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
